merchant/30090.htm.text: Trader Sandra: There are so many amazing things in this world! I've never seen them, but I've heard about blazing swords and magic shoes that can make you fly! Do you believe that these things really exist? Have you seen them? We have many amazing accessories here, but those items seem almost unrea…

links.text: View information about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30090-pk.htm.text: Trader Sandra: Get out, get out! If people like you frequent our store, we'd be sure to lose all our customers. Get out immediately!

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30094-01.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: You came from the boutique shop. Mr.Galladucci's order is ready. It was very hard for me to find. Do you have the order document?

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30090-01.html.text: Jeweler Sandra: You're from the country aren't you? Gludio Territory was once beautiful, but it's dangerous to travel nowadays. I have the earrings, you want to see? Beautiful and practical.

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30116-01.html.text: Priest Dustin: This place is sacred, where people of faith come to worship. Please keep a respectful silence here. Why are you here, my child?

links.text: "I brought this order from Mr. Galladucci."

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30094-04.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: I'm sure I gave you the item! Take the Magic Sword Hilt to Trader Galladucci at the boutique shop .

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30090-04.html.text: Jeweler Sandra: Gemstone Powder is expensive, so please deliver it to Galladucci at the boutique store quickly. Don't get distracted!

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30116-04.html.text: Priest Dustin: The necklace is completely purified and safe. Please deliver it to Mr. Galladucci at the boutique shop . I pray that tranquility and happiness will follow you always.

Q00381_LetsBecomeARoyalMember/30090-01.h.text: Sandra: Do you have the high-quality coin collection book? It's no longer for sale. Too many collectors dilute the market. You must do me a favor if you really want a book. It shouldn't be too hard for you, but there's no way I could do it. Will you help me?

Q00381_LetsBecomeARoyalMember/30090-05.h.text: Sandra: You still have the high-quality coin collection book that I gave you, don't you? Don't you need it for something? Think carefully.

Q00381_LetsBecomeARoyalMember/30090-04.h.text: Sandra: You've brought the rare golden clover coin ! Look how shiny it is! Note the exquisite pattern! It's a work of art! Now you're qualified to be a top-quality coin collector. Take this high-quality coin collection book .

Q00381_LetsBecomeARoyalMember/30090-03.h.text: Sandra: You still haven't found the rare golden clover coin . I won't give you the high-quality coin collection book for free. At the last meeting of the Coin Collection Club, they concluded that there were too many high-level coin collection books. They've forbidden me to sell them. The rare golde…

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30090-02.html.text: Jeweler Sandra: I have prepared everything for you. It's mostly the magicians of the Ivory Tower at Oren Castle that are ordering the Gemstone Powder , so it's quite expensive. Watch out for pickpockets in the crowds! Deliver it to Trader Galladucci quickly.

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30090-03.html.text: Jeweler Sandra: You didn't come here to buy something? I can't give the products to you without the order form from the boutique store.

Q00381_LetsBecomeARoyalMember/30090-02.h.text: Sandra: I'm a coin collector, too. A while back, another coin collector told me that the rare coins of Elmore were also quite valuable, although the war has left most trade routes to Elmore impassable. But this didn't slow me down! A delivery of very valuable coins has been stolen by Fallen Chiefta…
